slots.description: ["Turn your photo into a hand-drawn Demon Slayer-inspired portrait created by a human artist, not an AI filter. Anime Cabinet captures your expression, hairstyle, eye colour, and defining details, then reimagines you as an original Corps-inspired character. Choose a calm, disciplined pose or a fierce battle-ready expression, and suggest a breathing style such as Water, Flame, Thunder, or your own original concept.","The artwork can feature flowing haori patterns, nichirin-inspired sword details, elemental motion, and the rich colour contrast fans love from the series. Half-body photos give the artist room to design your uniform, collar, sword placement, and background effects. Couples, families, siblings, and friend groups can be illustrated together, with complementary haori colours or different elemental motifs for each person. Glasses, beauty marks, distinctive brows, earrings, and other recognisable details can be carried into the final composition so the result still feels like you joining the Corps—not a replacement for a copyrighted character.","A custom Demon Slayer portrait starts at $39.99, depending on the number of people and the artwork option you choose. After you order, send clear reference photos and your creative notes through the commission form. A human artist sends your first preview within 72 hours, and unlimited free revisions are included so you can request adjustments to colours, pose, expression, clothing details, or effects. Browse the [Anime Cabinet homepage](/) to see more of our 24 anime and cartoon styles, or read our [Demon Slayer-inspired custom poster guide](/blog/demon-slayer-inspired-custom-poster) for ideas before ordering. For gifting inspiration, explore our [best gifts for Demon Slayer fans](/blog/best-gifts-for-demon-slayer-fans)."]
